$comment: Fixed inputs for the day-one listening test (provider_shortlist.md section 5, research.md R5). Three sentences per dialect: one warning sign, one medicine line with an English drug name and a number, one follow-up date. Synthetic content only - no real patient, no real hospital. Do not edit between provider runs, or the blind comparison is worthless.

sentences.text: 如果胸口痛、氣促或者隻腳腫，即刻返急症室。
兩個禮拜之後返專科門診覆診，要空肚抽血。
如果出现胸痛、气促或者腿肿，请立即去急诊。
氨氯地平片 5mg，一片，每天一次。
两周后到心内科门诊复诊，需要空腹抽血。
